name: directional_convexity
mechanism: Buy bounded-loss convex exposure when a frozen Dummy distribution implies underpriced directional tails.
economic_rationale: A calibrated distribution can favor convex payoff over linear exposure when optionality is not too expensive.
falsifiable_hypothesis: After complete costs, long-option lower-bound utility exceeds risk-matched underlying and no-trade baselines.
reopen_condition: qualifying chronological quote corpus

name: defined_risk_directional_spreads
mechanism: Use exact one-to-one verticals to exchange some convexity for lower volatility cost.
economic_rationale: Capped payoffs may better match a bounded directional distribution and reduce vega or theta spend.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen vertical-selection rule improves lower-bound utility over long option, underlying, fixed vertical, and no trade.
reopen_condition: timestamped package quotes and fill witnesses

name: realized_vs_implied_volatility
mechanism: Express a predeclared difference between forecast realized volatility and cost-adjusted implied volatility.
economic_rationale: Option value depends on the path of realized volatility relative to implied and hedging costs.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen forecast and hedge policy produces positive cost-adjusted lower-bound utility against market-implied and no-trade baselines.
reopen_condition: point_in_time intraday options and underlying corpus

name: volatility_risk_premium
mechanism: Harvest only strictly bounded volatility premium with explicit crash protection and tail accounting.
economic_rationale: Implied volatility can exceed subsequent realized volatility as compensation for bearing convex tail risk.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A defined-risk premium policy survives full tail, gap, spread, assignment, and selection-aware tests.
reopen_condition: multi-regime point-in-time corpus including crises

name: skew_relative_value
mechanism: Trade bounded relative mispricing across strikes after enforcing surface consistency.
economic_rationale: Local skew can deviate from a stable conditional distribution or related contracts.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Static-arbitrage-clean skew residuals predict cost-adjusted relative convergence out of sample.
reopen_condition: validated arbitrage-consistent surface snapshots

name: term_structure_calendar_relative_value
mechanism: Use defined-risk calendars or diagonals when maturities imply inconsistent conditional variance or event premia.
economic_rationale: Different expirations can misallocate event and non-event variance.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen calendar rule beats matched single-expiration structures after package costs and path risk.
unresolved_gaps: calendar structures prohibited in v1 topology
reopen_condition: new environment and exact bounded calendar topology

name: event_volatility
mechanism: Separate event variance from ordinary variance and trade only predeclared bounded event structures.
economic_rationale: Scheduled events create discontinuous distributions and term-structure distortions.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Event-specific forecasts improve proper scores and cost-adjusted utility over market-implied and no-trade baselines.
reopen_condition: versioned event calendar and quote history

name: cross_sectional_volatility
mechanism: Rank comparable underlyings by forecast-versus-implied volatility with neutralized common exposures.
economic_rationale: Relative forecasts may be more stable than absolute volatility levels.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A purged cross-sectional rule improves lower-bound utility after correlation, sector, and cost controls.
reopen_condition: survivorship-safe cross-sectional corpus

name: dispersion_and_correlation
mechanism: Compare index-implied correlation with component distributions using strictly bounded packages.
economic_rationale: Index and component option prices jointly encode correlation risk premia.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A bounded dispersion rule adds utility after component costs, corporate events, and correlation stress.
reopen_condition: synchronized index component NBBO and exact bounded package policy

name: delta_hedged_gamma_capture
mechanism: Buy convexity and follow a frozen delta-hedging schedule when expected realized path variation exceeds option and hedge costs.
economic_rationale: Dynamic hedging can monetize gamma but is highly sensitive to path, jumps, and friction.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Frozen hedging rules beat unhedged long option and no trade under executable intraday prices.
reopen_condition: intraday quote and hedge execution evidence

name: surface_dislocation
mechanism: Detect local deviations from an arbitrage-consistent volatility surface and express only bounded repairs.
economic_rationale: Bad or stale quotes can create apparent dislocations, so source validation is part of the mechanism.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Validated residuals converge after costs more often than stale-quote and randomized controls.
reopen_condition: certified surface and quote anomaly controls

name: synthetic_equivalent_financing
mechanism: Compare options packages with synthetic or underlying equivalents after dividends, borrow, rates, and exercise economics.
economic_rationale: Put-call relationships can reveal financing or borrow differences, but frictions often consume them.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Executable package economics beat risk-matched alternatives after every carry and lifecycle cost.
reopen_condition: complete point-in-time carry and lifecycle inputs

name: liquidity_and_microstructure
mechanism: Select contracts and paper limit prices using spread, depth, age, venue, and adverse-selection state.
economic_rationale: Execution quality can add value without changing upstream forecasts.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen execution policy improves achieved paper price and fill-adjusted utility over naive immediate and naive limit baselines.
reopen_condition: qualifying market-structure data

name: dynamic_hedging
mechanism: Adjust bounded exposures using a frozen state-dependent hedge rule.
economic_rationale: Hedges can control nonlinear risk but repeated trading may destroy utility.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A state-dependent hedge policy improves expected shortfall without eliminating net utility after all costs.
unresolved_gaps: higher Greeks and intraday data unavailable
reopen_condition: certified higher Greeks and intraday execution corpus

name: regime_conditioned_structure_selection
mechanism: Route the same frozen opportunity among validated structures or abstention using only predecision regime state.
economic_rationale: Different payoff shapes may dominate under different volatility, liquidity, and event states.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen router beats global-best, equal-weight, simple-regime, and no-trade baselines on held-out eras.
reopen_condition: multiple L3 or higher specialists and held-out regimes

name: probability_calibrated_abstention
mechanism: Reject opportunities when calibration, evidence completeness, price, or regime familiarity falls below frozen thresholds.
economic_rationale: Passing on low-quality markets can improve robust utility and reduce false certainty.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Predeclared abstention improves lower-bound utility and calibration without merely deleting adverse outcomes post hoc.
reopen_condition: prospective immutable opportunity and settlement stream

name: portfolio_greek_optimization
mechanism: Allocate only among validated candidates under conjunctive nonlinear Greek, tail, liquidity, and concentration caps.
economic_rationale: Nominally distinct trades may share hidden exposure and should be sized jointly.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen constrained allocator improves lower-bound portfolio utility over equal-risk and fixed-size baselines.
reopen_condition: certified lifecycle-aware Greeks and stress covariance

name: tail_risk_overlays
mechanism: Add bounded protection only when marginal expected-shortfall reduction justifies premium and carry.
economic_rationale: Tail overlays can preserve survival but persistent overpayment can destroy returns.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen overlay improves lower-tail utility over unhedged and constant-hedge baselines across crisis eras.
reopen_condition: multi-crisis point-in-time options corpus

name: option_vs_underlying_selection
mechanism: Choose options, risk-matched underlying, or abstention from the same immutable opportunity.
economic_rationale: Options are valuable only when convexity, capital efficiency, or bounded risk outweigh volatility and execution costs.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen instrument selector adds incremental utility over always-option, always-underlying, and no-trade policies.
reopen_condition: same-opportunity option and underlying comparison corpus

name: simple_transparent_rules
mechanism: Use minimal fixed thresholds and exact bounded structures as complexity controls.
economic_rationale: Simple policies reduce selection surface and expose whether complexity pays rent.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A transparent rule survives costs and provides a stable benchmark across temporal blocks.
reopen_condition: qualifying multi-regime corpus

name: machine_learning_models
mechanism: Map predecision features to distributions or abstention with nested chronological selection and strict complexity penalties.
economic_rationale: Nonlinear interactions may add information, but search flexibility creates severe overfit risk.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen model improves proper scores and lower-bound utility over simple models after selection-aware correction.
reopen_condition: adequate point-in-time sample and sealed model-selection design

name: bayesian_state_space_models
mechanism: Estimate latent volatility or regime state with explicit posterior uncertainty and abstention.
economic_rationale: Sequential uncertainty may be more defensible than fixed point estimates in nonstationary markets.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Posterior predictive scores and routed utility exceed simpler filters out of sample.
reopen_condition: adequate chronological corpus and prior sensitivity protocol

name: execution_only_improvements
mechanism: Hold the opportunity and structure fixed while optimizing paper price selection, cancellation, and package timing.
economic_rationale: Downstream execution quality is independently measurable against the exact same frozen opportunities.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen execution policy improves price quality and fill-adjusted utility without changing trade selection.
reopen_condition: timestamped paper order and witness stream

name: position_management_improvements
mechanism: Hold entry fixed and compare frozen hold, trim, hedge, roll, or close policies without outcome-conditioned rewriting.
economic_rationale: State changes may justify management, but extra trades add costs and degrees of freedom.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A predeclared management policy adds lower-bound utility over hold-to-rule and immediate-close baselines.
reopen_condition: prospective immutable trade-path data

name: behavioral_and_process_controls
mechanism: Detect size creep, loss chasing, FOMO, override patterns, and rule drift from an immutable decision ledger.
economic_rationale: Preventing process deterioration can preserve capital even without forecasting alpha.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Frozen circuit breakers reduce policy violations and tail loss without increasing hidden overrides.
reopen_condition: prospective decision and override history

name: no_trade_policies
mechanism: Return abstention whenever evidence, economics, authority, or risk gates fail.
economic_rationale: Avoiding negative-edge or unknowable markets is a first-class capability.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A frozen no-trade boundary improves robust utility and calibration relative to weaker thresholds while preserving honest coverage reporting.
reopen_condition: prospective opportunity and settlement corpus
